description: Changes the app's own tokens (tokens module), bought in packs and spent on items: "setConfig" { config } merges settings; "voidSpend" { spendId, reason? } gives a spend's tokens back to the user; "saveCut" { name } saves the report as it is now. Neblla only keeps the ledger; it never holds the money. Not here: gifting tokens (panel only), packs (neblla_create_product tokens), stalls and items (neblla_vendors), reads (neblla_tokens_read). More: neblla_get_llms tools/tokens

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

config.description: setConfig: kinds, commissionPercent, floor (above the suggested one needs acceptAbove), expiry, refunds, pause { buy, spend }, eventDate, vendorNotice.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

reason.description: voidSpend: why, kept with the spend.

until.description: saveCut: covers up to this ISO date (default now).

name: neblla_tokens
title: Configure app tokens
